id: title:Gilbert09:stop retrying a deterministic 406 on collection discovery

review.posthog_relevance: Changes the Webflow warehouse source connector's error handling to stop retrying requests that receive a 406 status, treating this as a permanent account eligibility or plan mismatch rather than a transient network or transient content-negotiation issue.
review.reason: Adds a new entry to the non-retryable error dictionary, treating Webflow 406 Not Acceptable errors as deterministic and not retryable, and adds a unit test asserting that the connector recognizes the 406 error message as non-retryable.
review.uncertainty: While the code change is substantive and bounded, the actual benefit depends on the frequency and impact of transient 406 errors in the Webflow connector, which is not established by the patch. The tier is assigned based on the implementation of a correctness improvement, not on demonstrated production benefit.

observations.limitations: Only supplied hunk IDs are cited. No score assigned.
